data_fields.name: chat_short_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 (warn at 2 in the short window, kick at 3)

data_fields.name: chat_long_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 (warn at 3 in the long window, kick at 4)

best_idea: Rate-limit chat per client with two tiers (warn at the limit, disconnect one step past it), count every line in a sliding window, and check each line before it is relayed.
decision_why: The two-tier warn-then-disconnect rule and per-kind windows are simple and fit server-side chat checks. Reject the absorb run, which lets steady senders through unchecked, and the donor's relay-before-check order.
acceptance: A server test with absorb 0, cap 2 in 10 s and 3 in 30 s: a client sending one line per second gets WARNING on line 3 (t = 2 s), is disconnected on line 4 (t = 3 s), and line 4 is never delivered to the room.
